gen-press-start-2p-gf-basic: Pixel-pinned and playful. Press Start 2P scatters its blocky letters wide apart, while Basic tucks in with a gentle step from small letters up to capitals and a low-key, tidy finish.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans reads as one plain stripe of ink, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Press Start 2P brings a faint shimmer of weight shifts above it, so the two feel like arcade lettering over a smooth sans.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-carlito: Retro and cheerful, Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart with big lowercase bowls. And Carlito, a plain sans, winds its tight, round letters close, so shrinking that heading would flatten its faint thick-thin shift.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-changa: Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart, with crossbars a touch thinner than the stems. Changa's lowercase stands tall like cast iron capitals, so a long read moves steadily.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-days-one: Chunky pixel charm, then a sturdy follow-up. Press Start 2P is best at showing off its mild stroke modulation and wide-set letters, but Days One, a plain sans, is best at filling the line with a big x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-epunda-sans: Letters pinned far apart like cut-out shapes define Press Start 2P. It does its best work with a comfortable shift between robust downstrokes and slender turns, while Epunda Sans, a plain sans, gives oversized e and a counters with plenty of daylight inside.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-farro: Arcade swagger over wire-bent simplicity. Press Start 2P offers thin strokes of respectable weight and wide-spaced letters, and Farro, a sans-serif, counters with compressed ascenders and strokes of exactly no contrast.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lays its letters out like nails on a ruler, with a tall waist line and strokes of one width. Press Start 2P adds thin strokes not far from thick, making the pair a playful versus precise contrast.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-geist-mono: Wide-set, cut-out letters with big open lowercase bowls mark Press Start 2P, and its thin strokes sit beside moderately weighty stems. Geist Mono, a monospace, simply keeps a gentle monotone line with high-rising lowercase.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-genos: Contemporary and quick, Genos presses its glyphs so close their edges almost kiss. Press Start 2P shines at wide-spaced, bowl-heavy display lettering, while this plain sans is best at a high-set midline that never snags.
